commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
90+4' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
90+2' Here's the change. Aimar Oroz leaves the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
89' The referee shows the yellow card to Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).

89' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Pulido with no other option than to blow for a foul. Osasuna have a free kick.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Roberto Lopez (Leganes) will replace Aritz Arambarri.
88' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente is replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Renato Tapia (Leganes) comes onto the pitch so that Darko Brasanac can be given a rest.

86' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Juan Soriano with a fabulous save.
86' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
84' OFF THE POST! Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
82' The game is interrupted. Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
79' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Juan Soriano (Leganes) puts the ball into his own net.
79' Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' The ball is cleared after Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner.
78' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Ruben Pena (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
76' Flag up against Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
74' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
74' The substitution is prepared. Julian Chicco (Leganes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Seydouba Cisse.
73' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
73' The attendance for today's match is 19561.
73' It seemed like Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
72' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna have been awarded a free kick.
71' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.

70' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

64' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
63' Here comes a substitution. Dani Raba (Leganes) is brought on as a substitute for Juan Cruz.
61' The referee is firm and issues Juan Soriano (Leganes) a deserved yellow card.
60' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Moi Gomez and he is replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna).
60' That will be all from Abel Bretones who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
59' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

58' A neat pass is well received by Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
56' Juan Pulido blows his whistle as Abel Bretones (Osasuna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
51' Leganes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera makes a magnificent save! Leganes get a corner.
49' A rebound spins to Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
46' Vicente Moreno makes a switch. Jon Moncayola is coming on in place of Iker Munoz (Osasuna) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The linesman raises his flag. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is adjudged offside.
38' The ball possession is 52:48.
30' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) picks up a yellow card.
29' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Looks like Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

22' 0 - 1 Javi Hernandez sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Juan Cruz (Leganes) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.
21' Juan Cruz (Leganes) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
21' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) brings his opponent down. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Leganes.
16' Juan Cruz (Leganes) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

16' What a great chance for Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the foot of the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
16' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Leganes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leganes. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leganes.
15' A cross from Darko Brasanac (Leganes) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Leganes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
10' Close effort! Javi Hernandez (Leganes) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
9' Dangerous play by Lucas Torro (Osasuna). Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Leganes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
2' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Pulido.
